# MetadataTraits

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Output` in assembly `Nfty.Core`.

```csharp
public static class MetadataTraits
```

Which traits an asset publishes, and in which SHAPE of metadata.

## Remarks

**Shape 1** (what every Set cooked before this existed carries): one attribute per present layer plus `Type`. A rolled color is invisible, and a layer the roll left out is invisible too, so two assets differing only in a hue publish identical traits.

**Shape 2** (new cooks): additionally a `"{Layer} Color"` attribute right after each Dynamic or Static layer's own (named by [`ColorName`](Nfty.Core.Imaging.ColorName.md) from the UNROUNDED rolled color; Custom layers carry none), and an explicit [`MetadataTraits.Absent`](Nfty.Core.Output.MetadataTraits.md#f-absent) value for each OPTIONAL layer the roll left out. One function builds this list, so the OpenSea file, the rich file's rarity rows and the collection rarity table cannot spell a trait two ways.

**The shape is recorded** in `set.json` ([`SetManifest.MetadataShape`](Nfty.Core.Output.SetManifest.md#p-metadatashape), absent = 1) so `extend` writes new items in the Set's own shape and never rewrites an already-published file's attributes: a Set is one shape throughout, which keeps its rarity table consistent. Neither names nor shapes ever enter the DNA.
